sloka: येनाहं सहसा स्पृष्टश्शोणितेन दुरात्मना ।कोऽयं दुरात्मा दुर्भुदि्घरकृतात्मा च बालिशः ॥४-११-५०॥।।
transliteration: yenāhaṁ sahasā spṛṣṭaśśoṇitena durātmanā ।ko'yaṁ durātmā durbhudi्gharakṛtātmā ca bāliśaḥ ॥4-11-50॥।।

translations.english: 'Who is that petty, wicked, evil minded one who caused the drops of blood to touch (fall on) me suddenly?
